snippet.title: Mage of the Olekta Desert - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Aisha receives a job to deliver a letter to the mage living in the Olekta Desert. To her dismay, she must traverse the dangerous ruins that stand in her way and defeat the bandits and cultists that roam inside.
